tex_content.html: Let $V\Subset W$ be open sets star-shaped with respect to $0$, set $U=W\setminus \overline V$, $\Gamma _0=\partial W$, and $\Gamma _1=\partial V$, and let $u$ solve \[ \begin{cases} -\Delta u=0 & \text{in }U,\\ u=1 & \text{on }\Gamma _1,\\ u=0 & \text{on }\Gamma _0. \end{cases} \tag {1} \] Then $0<u<1$ in $U$.
